subject_field.description: A declared digest subject on the human wait, binding policy and target.

oneOf.description:
Trusted recovery imports an actual post-backup provider receipt. It does
not dispatch a call or recreate the missing attempt history.

call_identity.description: Service principal binding, not an authenticated human actor assertion.

target.description: Logical provider/resource boundary, resolved by the host without secrets.

ExecutionGrant.description:
Issued by a trusted host after authorization. A digest is a binding, not a signature.
Keep this on a separate authenticated control channel from model/worker messages.

expected_instances.description: Requirement ID -> exact node instance; later loop rounds cannot reuse it.

exception.description: Explicit permission to accept this scope despite the unchanged verdict.

actor.description:
Trusted local administrator annotation. Remote roles must be checked by
an authenticated service; this string alone grants no authority.

MigrationAuthority.description:
Fenced execution proof for a protected definition migration. The plan and
complete target contract are retained by the corresponding kernel event.

ModelCheckpoint.description: A host-owned checkpoint, never accepted from model output as authority.

binding_digest.description: Host binding fingerprint excludes credential values.

feedback.description: Next-iteration input field -> failed body terminal input field.

oneOf.description:
Provider guarantees this invocation did not apply an effect. Timeouts,
transport errors and ambiguous HTTP 5xx must use Unknown instead.
A query found nothing *at that instant*. It does not fence an old writer.

Postcondition.description: Mandatory success postcondition, frozen with its graph and policy in the run bundle.

input_node.description: The current frame's task whose resolved inputs identify the checked subject.

evidence.description: Must describe actual source retirement and post-backup provider audit.

no_missing_effect_intents.description: Operator verified that every post-backup admitted write is accounted for.

generation.description: Random restore generation. This is a fencing identity, not a credential.

subject_field.description: Required task input containing the exact ReleaseSubject object.

subject.description: Actual subject observed by the gateway, never merely copied from input.

pass_field.description: Required Boolean in the accepted worker output; artifact text is not a verdict.

max_calls.description: Includes queries and writes; persists across leases and process restarts.

input_digest.description: Digest of the common inputs actually checked by each required task.

oneOf.description: Gateway atomically compares the full subject and applies the operation.

Gateway observes before writing; the declared query is required after
ambiguous outcomes. This mode does not claim to close the external race.
The process died after admission; no tool observation was durably acknowledged.

VerifiedFact.description: Values copied from acknowledged task outputs, not assertions invented by a model.

VersionRef.description: Versions are immutable opaque release identifiers, never ranges or `latest`.

max_validity_ms.description: Response expiry must be within this duration of durable receipt.

subjects.description: Names of required wait inputs whose exact values are being reviewed.

model_record.description: Explicit model/tool decisions. The policy executor and durable host validate its schema.
